messages:
Asha: Quick async — gateway/routing/auth/rate limits check-in.
Asha: What I did: merged routing policy that prefers region-local pools (PR #409), added unit tests for policy selection.
Asha: Blocker: e2e auth integration failing in staging — header parity mismatch when proxy rewrites X-Client-Id.
Asha: Today: debug staging e2e, coordinate canary rollout, and ping for CR on #413.

Raj: Noted. I saw the failing test logs; the auth middleware strips trailing whitespace on client-id now.
Raj: I left comments on PR #409 — minor nit, but shouldn't cause e2e fail. Will take a look at #413 later today.
Raj: @Olivia can you confirm whether the token header normalization landed in the private auth branch?

Olivia: I'm on the auth work. The normalization landed but behind a feature flag for hybrid clients.
Olivia: I'll add a compatibility pass to preserve legacy header format when feature flag is off.
Olivia: Pushing a patch in ~2 hrs.

Micah: Heads-up — rate limit alerts spiked at 03:12 UTC for bucket `tenant:acme-prod`: sustained ~1.5k RPS.
Micah: Quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-16T03:12:08Z WARN rl: tenant=acme-prod rate=1500 limit=1000 window=1s
2026-03-16T03:12:09Z INFO gateway: routing to pool us-east-2
```
Micah: Could be a client bug or bursty traffic, seems to originate from /v1/generate.

Dave: I dug into the dashboards — it's a retry storm from a client not handling 429s.
Dave: I throttled that tenant to token-based RB (burst=200, sustained=600) and applied a short circuit for retries.
Dave: Opened ops-ticket #789 to contact the customer and revert if it's a false positive.

Asha: Thanks Dave. Can you also add a temporary routing rule to prefer dedicated pools for acme-prod until they onboard throttles?

Dave: Yup, adding canary rule now. Rolling in staging, will push to prod after validation. :hammer_and_wrench: 

Raj: Small CR note — in the routing policy code please prefer explicit pool tag over inferred locality; reduces surprises.

Olivia: Patch pushed: fixes header normalization and adds a feature-flag check. Ran unit tests locally. Will request e2e run once CI frees up.

Asha: Ping for review: PR #413 (routing fallback) and PR #414 (auth normalization) — tag: @Raj @Olivia. Short CRs, should be quick.

Raj: Picked up #413. Will review in the next 2 hrs.

Micah: Also, a reminder — the console shows elevated token costs due to increased small requests; might want caching on prefix for /embed endpoints.
Micah: Filing a recommendation doc in the repo later today.

Asha: Good call. Let's also add a temporary caching rule on the gateway edge for small embeddings responses (TTL 30s) — low risk.

Dave: Implemented the edge TTL in staging routes. Testing now.

deploy-bot: deploy started for service: gateway, user: dave, commit: 7f3a2c4

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: gateway@staging in 2m 18s

Asha: Awesome. If the staging e2e passes after Olivia's patch, we'll proceed with canary tonight 22:00 UTC.
Asha: Blockers for today: none besides e2e wait. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
